tha-ap324:1.1: Pulinapūjaka.] Kakudhaṃ vilasantaṃ va nisabhājāniyaṃ yathā / osadhīva virocantaṃ obhāsentaṃ narāsabhaṃ. // //
tha-ap324:2.1: Añjaliṃ paggahetvāna avandiṃ satthuno ahaṃ / satthāraṃ parivaṇṇesiṃ sakakammena tosito. // // Susuddhaṃ
tha-ap324:3.1: pulinaṃ gayha gatamagge samokiriṃ / ucchaṅgena gahetvāna Vipassissa mahesino. // //
tha-ap324:4.1: Tato upaḍḍhapulinaṃ vippasannena cetasā / divāvihāre osiñciṃ dipadindassa tādino. // //
tha-ap324:5.1: Ekanavute ito kappe pulinaṃ yam āsiñc' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pulinassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap324:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pulinapūjako thero i. g. a-ti.
